pointers.sentence: The rest is `BaseStorage`'s ([Messages: `add_message`, `Message` and `MessageMiddleware`](messages.md)) (`django/contrib/messages/storage/base.py:BaseStorage`).

`MessageEncoder` turns each `Message` into a JSON list: the marker `"__json_message"`, 1 if the text is safe HTML (a `SafeData`) and 0 if not, the level, the text, and the extra tags unless they are `None` (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:MessageEncoder.default`).

`MessageDecoder` walks the decoded JSON through lists and dictionaries and turns each list that begins with the marker back into a `Message`, passing the text through `mark_safe` when the flag is 1 (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:MessageDecoder.process_messages`).

The JSON is signed by the signer `get_cookie_signer` makes, with the salt `CookieStorage.key_salt`, `"django.contrib.messages"`: an instance of the class `SIGNING_BACKEND` names, `TimestampSigner` by default ([Signing: `Signer`, `TimestampSigner`, `dumps` and `loads`](../security/signing.md)) (`django/core/signing.py:get_cookie_signer`).

`CookieStorage._encode_parts` calls `Signer.sign_object` with compression, which compresses only when that saves space and marks compressed data with a leading `"."` (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:CookieStorage._encode_parts`).

`CookieStorage._decode` checks it with `Signer.unsign_object` and no maximum age, so the time is never compared and a message cookie does not expire by its signature (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:CookieStorage._decode`).
With nothing to store it deletes the cookie ([Cookies](../http/cookies.md)) (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:CookieStorage._update_cookie`).

When the last item is `CookieStorage.not_finished`, the string `"__messagesnotfinished__"` (the **not-finished marker**), it removes it and answers that not every message was retrieved (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:CookieStorage._get`).
When it does not, it looks by bisection for the longest run of messages that fits with the not-finished marker after it (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:CookieStorage._store`).
Either way the cookie ends with the marker (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:bisect_keep_right`, `django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:bisect_keep_left`).
Either way the cookie ends with the marker (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:bisect_keep_right`, `django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:bisect_keep_left`).

`SessionStorage` keeps the messages in the session under `SessionStorage.session_key`, `"_messages"`, and refuses to be made for a request without a session ([Authentication, sessions and messages](../auth.md)) (`django/contrib/messages/storage/session.py:SessionStorage.__init__`).

It stores the list as a string: `SessionStorage.serialize_messages` encodes it with `MessageEncoder`, the same lists as in the cookie, and `SessionStorage.deserialize_messages` decodes a non-empty string with `MessageDecoder` and returns anything else as it found it, `None` included (`django/contrib/messages/storage/session.py:SessionStorage.deserialize_messages`).
`SessionStorage._store` sets the entry when it has messages, removes it when it has none, and returns an empty list (`django/contrib/messages/storage/session.py:SessionStorage._store`).

`FallbackStorage.storage_classes` is `CookieStorage` and then `SessionStorage`, and a `FallbackStorage` makes one of each for its request (`django/contrib/messages/storage/fallback.py:FallbackStorage`).

It stops at a storage that returns `None`, as one that was not used does, and after one that has retrieved everything; it notes which storages held messages (`django/contrib/messages/storage/fallback.py:FallbackStorage._get`).

A storage given nothing that held messages when they were read is emptied, so the cookie is deleted and the session's entry removed (`django/contrib/messages/storage/fallback.py:FallbackStorage._store`).
Django's documentation gives the reason for trying the cookie first: it avoids writing to the session whenever possible, and should perform best in the general case (`docs/ref/contrib/messages.txt`).

Under `FallbackStorage` the mark falls on the storage inside, which nothing asks (`django/contrib/messages/storage/cookie.py:CookieStorage._decode`, `django/contrib/messages/storage/base.py:BaseStorage.update`).
